story.text: 오랜만에 스케줄이 완전히 빈 토요일, 용우가 먼저 나를 불러냈다. '오늘은 낚시나 가자. 나 쉬는 날엔 원래 이거 한다.'
story.reading: o-raen-man-e seu-ke-jul-i wan-jeon-hi bin to-yo-il, yong-u-ga meon-jeo na-reul bul-leo-naet-da. o-neul-eun nak-si-na ga-ja. na swi-neun nal-en won-lae i-geo han-da.
story.en: One Saturday, with his schedule surprisingly wide open for once, Yongwoo called out to me first. "Let's go fishing today. This is what I do on my days off."

story.text: 협재 근처 갯바위에 도착하자, 그는 트렁크에서 낚싯대 두 대를 꺼내며 익숙하게 채비를 폈다.
story.reading: hyeop-jae geun-cheo gaet-ba-wi-e do-chak-ha-ja, geu-neun teu-reong-keu-e-seo nak-ssit-dae du dae-reul kkeo-nae-myeo ig-suk-ha-ge chae-bi-reul pyeot-da.
story.en: When we arrived at the rocky shore near Hyeopjae, he pulled two fishing rods out of the trunk and set up the tackle with practiced ease.

story.text: '미끼는 이렇게 꿰는 거다.' 용우가 바늘에 미끼를 꿰어 보이며 말했다. 처음 보는 손놀림에 나는 눈을 떼지 못했다.
story.reading: mi-kki-neun i-reo-ke kkwe-neun geo-da. yong-u-ga ba-neul-e mi-kki-reul kkwe-eo bo-i-myeo mal-haet-da. cheo-eum bo-neun son-nol-lim-e na-neun nun-eul tte-ji mot-haet-da.
story.en: "This is how you thread the bait." Yongwoo said, showing me how to hook the bait onto the line. I couldn't take my eyes off his unfamiliar, practiced movements.

story.text: '이제 던지고 기다리면 돼. 조급해하지 말고.' 낚싯대를 건네받은 나는 그가 시키는 대로 바다를 향해 힘껏 던졌다.
story.reading: i-je deon-ji-go gi-da-ri-myeon dwae. jo-geup-hae-ha-ji mal-go. nak-ssit-dae-reul geon-ne-bad-eun na-neun geu-ga si-ki-neun dae-ro ba-da-reul hyang-hae him-kkeot deon-jyeot-da.
story.en: "Now just cast it and wait. Don't be impatient." Taking the rod he handed me, I cast it out toward the sea with all my strength, just as he told me.

story.text: 한참을 기다려도 아무 반응이 없자 지루해진 나는 하품을 했다. 용우는 눈 하나 깜짝 안 하고 찌만 바라보고 있었다.
story.reading: han-cham-eul gi-da-ryeo-do a-mu ban-eung-i eop-ja ji-ru-hae-jin na-neun ha-pum-eul haet-da. yong-u-neun nun ha-na kkam-jjak an ha-go jji-man ba-ra-bo-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: After a long wait with no response at all, I grew bored and yawned. Yongwoo, meanwhile, didn't so much as blink, just kept staring at the float.

story.text: '취미는 원래 기다리는 맛이다.' 그가 낮은 목소리로 말한 순간, 내 낚싯대 끝이 갑자기 팽팽하게 휘었다.
story.reading: chwi-mi-neun won-lae gi-da-ri-neun mas-i-da. geu-ga naj-eun mok-so-ri-ro mal-han sun-gan, nae nak-ssit-dae kkeut-i gap-ja-gi paeng-paeng-ha-ge hwi-eot-da.
story.en: "A hobby is, by nature, all about the taste of waiting." The moment he said that in his low voice, the tip of my rod suddenly bent taut.

story.text: '왔다, 왔어! 천천히 감아 봐라.' 그의 다급한 목소리에 손이 떨렸다. 줄 끝에서 전해지는 짜릿한 손맛에 나도 모르게 소리를 질렀다.
story.reading: wat-da, wass-eo! cheon-cheon-hi gam-a bwa-ra. geu-ui da-geup-han mok-so-ri-e son-i tteol-lyeot-da. jul kkeut-e-seo jeon-hae-ji-neun jja-rit-han son-mas-e na-do mo-reu-ge so-ri-reul jil-leot-da.
story.en: "It's here, it's on! Reel it in slowly." His urgent voice made my hands tremble. At the thrilling tug transmitted through the line, I let out a shout without meaning to.

story.text: 작은 물고기 한 마리가 올라오자, 용우는 크기를 살피더니 다시 바다로 놓아주었다. '이건 너무 작다. 방생하자, 다음에 더 큰 놈으로 잡아라.'
story.reading: jag-eun mul-go-gi han ma-ri-ga ol-la-o-ja, yong-u-neun keu-gi-reul sal-pi-deo-ni da-si ba-da-ro no-a-ju-eot-da. i-geon neo-mu jak-da. bang-saeng-ha-ja, da-eum-e deo keun nom-eu-ro jab-a-ra.
story.en: A small fish came up on the line, and Yongwoo looked it over before releasing it back into the sea. "This one's too small. Let's set it free — next time, catch a bigger one."

story.text: 노을이 지는 바다를 보며 나란히 앉아 있으려니, 아무것도 안 하고 그냥 기다리는 이 시간이 이렇게 여유로울 수 있다는 걸 처음 알았다.
story.reading: no-eul-i ji-neun ba-da-reul bo-myeo na-ran-hi anj-a iss-eu-ryeo-ni, a-mu-geot-do an ha-go geu-nyang gi-da-ri-neun i si-gan-i i-reo-ke yeo-yu-ro-ul su it-da-neun geol cheo-eum al-at-da.
story.en: Sitting side by side watching the sunset paint the sea, I realized for the first time how leisurely it could feel to simply wait, doing nothing at all.

words.example_en: I packed my fishing rod and went to the sea.
I hooked the bait onto the line.

words.meaning: the thrill felt through the line when a fish bites
words.example_en: The thrill on the line is so exciting that I keep fishing.

words.meaning: to release a caught fish back into the water
words.example_en: I released the fish that was too small.
A weekend with no plans is relaxing.

sentences.en: After a long while, I packed my fishing rod and headed to the sea.

sentences.ko: 미끼를 바늘에 꿰는 법을 처음 배웠다.
sentences.reading: mi-kki-reul ba-neul-e kkwe-neun beob-eul cheo-eum bae-wot-da
sentences.en: I learned how to thread bait onto a hook for the first time.

sentences.ko: 물고기가 물자 손끝으로 짜릿한 손맛이 전해졌다.
sentences.reading: mul-go-gi-ga mul-ja son-kkeut-eu-ro jja-rit-han son-mas-i jeon-hae-jyeot-da
sentences.en: When the fish bit, a thrilling tug traveled through my fingertips.

sentences.ko: 크기가 작은 물고기는 다시 방생해 주었다.
sentences.reading: keu-gi-ga jag-eun mul-go-gi-neun da-si bang-saeng-hae ju-eot-da
sentences.en: I released the fish that was too small back into the water.

sentences.ko: 아무 약속 없이 여유롭게 하루를 보냈다.
sentences.reading: a-mu yak-sog eop-si yeo-yu-rop-ge ha-ru-reul bo-naet-da
sentences.en: I spent the day leisurely, with no plans at all.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 미끼는 이렇게 바늘 끝에 단단히 꿰는 거다.
turns.reading: mi-kki-neun i-reo-ke ba-neul kkeut-e dan-dan-hi kkwe-neun geo-da.
turns.en: You thread the bait onto the tip of the hook firmly, like this.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 저는 이런 거 처음 해 봐요. 좀 무섭네요.
turns.reading: jeo-neun i-reon geo cheo-eum hae bwa-yo. jom mu-seop-ne-yo.
turns.en: This is my first time doing something like this. It's a little scary.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 무섭긴, 몇 번 해 보면 금방 익숙해진다.
turns.reading: mu-seop-gin, myeot beon hae bo-myeon geum-bang ig-suk-hae-jin-da.
turns.en: Scary, my foot — do it a few times and you'll get used to it right away.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Then how do I cast it now?

dialogues.question: 용우가 승객에게 미끼 꿰는 법을 직접 보여준 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo personally showed the passenger how to bait the hook?
options: 승객이 미끼를 무서워해서 대신 해 주려고
dialogues.explanation: 승객이 낚시를 처음 해 본다고 하자 용우가 미끼 꿰는 법을 직접 보여주었습니다.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.en: It's here, it's on! Reel it in slowly.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 손이 떨려요! 이거 진짜 물고기 맞죠?
turns.reading: son-i tteol-lyeo-yo! i-geo jin-jja mul-go-gi mat-jyo?
turns.en: My hands are shaking! This is really a fish, right?

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 그래, 잘 잡았다. 근데 이건 너무 작으니까 놓아주자.
turns.reading: geu-rae, jal jab-at-da. geun-de i-geon neo-mu jag-eu-ni-kka no-a-ju-ja.
turns.en: Yeah, nice catch. But this one's too small, so let's let it go.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 아깝지 않아요? 그냥 가져가면 안 돼요?
turns.reading: a-kkap-ji an-a-yo? geu-nyang ga-jyeo-ga-myeon an dwae-yo?
turns.en: Isn't that a waste? Can't we just keep it?

dialogues.question: 용우가 물고기를 다시 놓아주자고 한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo suggested releasing the fish?
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 잡은 물고기가 너무 작다며 다시 놓아주자고 했습니다.
